correctness.rationale: Halving b gives the affine recurrence with constant 1; the displayed Pell formula satisfies it and the two zero initial values. Squaring gives the five bases 1, lambda^(±1), lambda^(±2), constant term 5/64, and unit coefficients for all four nonconstant bases at every odd prime. The monic characteristic polynomial has constant -1, so any five consecutive windows generate the same gcd as the full sequence. For the least period modulo p, the norms of lambda^j-1 for j=1..4 exclude collisions except at 3 and 7; in the split algebra the coordinates of lambda are inverse, so a collision in one coordinate implies a collision in both. A unit Vandermonde then forces lambda^h=1 for any period h, and for p=3,7 the direct square sequences (0,0,1,1) and (0,0,1) give the exact periods instead. Window differences force that period to divide k; the unit geometric-sum denominators then leave 5k/64 modulo p. Lifting lambda^k-1 makes every nonconstant window term vanish one p-power beyond the constant term when p is not 5 and p divides k. At 5, lambda^3=-1 mod 5, its order is 6, and lambda^6-1=19600+13860*sqrt(2) has exact valuation 1. Odd-prime binomial lifting preserves the first nonzero normalized coefficient and gives exact valuation 1+v_5(k). If all windows vanished one level deeper, their differences and the invertible five-mode matrix at 5 would force the lambda mode deeper, a contradiction. The argument excludes every other odd prime case and makes no 2-adic claim.
residual_risks: Bounded replay does not establish the infinite classification or determine the power of two; those are respectively proved analytically and out of scope.

More decisively for even lengths, a distinct October 18 record already states the same valuation law at 5 and all primes >=11, for every length, for the identical gcd. It uses the same Pell modes and Vandermonde/prime-power mechanism. Only the even-length cases at 3 and 7 are outside these two demonstrable overlaps. The record does not isolate that remainder as its contribution or distinguish it from material already covered. This is not an assertion that the same-day comparator came first or that the entire theorem was published earlier; the overlapping formulas, not an access problem or the shared date itself, prevent accepting the original broad novelty claim. A later complete factorization independently confirms how much of the statement overlaps the catalog; it is not used as evidence of earlier priority.
residual_risks: Same-day ordering and how the overlapping records relate are unresolved. There is no finding of false mathematics or of prior publication of the entire frozen theorem.
